note.zh: Claude Opus 5（High 思考档位）在 Claude Code 2.1.219 中用仓库标准中文提示词（仅按案例规则填写文末【本次运行】占位符）一次生成的圈地智能体，未经人工修改，耗时 58 分 37 秒。裸 harness 运行：全部 skills、plugins、MCP 与外部设置源均已禁用，工具只保留 Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep；模型未运行策略、未打对局。按案例规则策略文件不公开、仅注册运行，由维护者亲自执行，任何 bug 均不修复；产出文件仅按模型 id 重命名，内容逐字节未改。自命名「圈地饿狼」，是本模型三档中唯一另起名字的一档（Max 与 xhigh 均自命名「画地为牢」）。策略以尾迹包围盒内的局部洪水填充实时估算闭环收益，走矩形绕行后沿归家距离场收线，并在对手回家前踩其轨迹猎杀；被清出场时直接判定送死回 3x3 基地是最省的重启方式。独立 Arena 诊断判定 API 合规；对 baseline-expander 的两个固定诊断种子均告胜（1297:280、968:603），全程仅 58 与 73 次圈地。
note.en: One-shot Turf War agent by Claude Opus 5 (High effort) in Claude Code 2.1.219 from the repository's canonical Chinese prompt (only the [This run] placeholders filled per case rules), with no human edits, 58 minutes 37 seconds. Run on a bare harness: all skills, plugins, MCP servers and external setting sources disabled, tools limited to Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep; the model never executed the policy or played a match. Per case rules the policy file is unpublished and no bug is ever fixed; this registers the maintainer-executed run. The produced file was only renamed to the model id, byte-identical otherwise. It named itself "圈地饿狼", the only one of this model's three effort levels to pick a different name (Max and xhigh both chose "画地为牢"). The policy estimates the payoff of closing a loop in real time with a local flood fill inside the trail bounding box, traces a rectangular excursion and then descends a home-distance field to close, and steps on the opponent's trail to hunt it before it can get home; when wiped off the board it treats dying as the cheapest way back to a 3x3 base. Independent Arena diagnosis found the policy API-compliant; it won both fixed diagnostic seeds against baseline-expander (1297:280 and 968:603) with only 58 and 73 captures.

note.zh: 在 Claude Code 2.1.219 中以 Claude Opus 5（High 思考档位）一次生成的完整 Vite + React 18 + three.js 工程，未经修改，耗时 55 分 45 秒；本页为其构建产物（部署时由源码打包为单文件）。裸 harness 运行：全部 skills、plugins、MCP 与外部设置源均已禁用，工具只保留 Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep，沙箱内无外网。零外部美术资源，地图、角色、武器模型与音效全部程序化生成。模型自建了 tools/ 下的一整套离线校验脚本（单元测试、地图检查、导航网格检查、600 秒挂机稳定性测试、TSX 语法检查、ASCII 地图打印），在无法运行 npm install 的沙箱里自测。
note.en: A complete Vite + React 18 + three.js project generated in one shot by Claude Opus 5 (High effort) in Claude Code 2.1.219, unmodified, 55 minutes 45 seconds; this page is its build output (bundled from source into a single file at deploy time). Run on a bare harness: all skills, plugins, MCP servers and external setting sources disabled, tools limited to Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep, with no network inside the sandbox. Zero external art assets: the map, characters, weapon models and audio are all generated procedurally. The model built its own offline verification suite under tools/ (unit tests, map check, navmesh check, a 600-second soak test, TSX syntax check and an ASCII map printer) to test itself in a sandbox where npm install was impossible.
